paragraphs.text: Pontotoc has varsity soccer at home Tuesday and a football trip to Lafayette on Thursday as its November schedule gets underway, according to the school’s athletics calendar.
The varsity girls soccer team is scheduled to host Ripley at 5 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3.
Pontotoc’s varsity football game at Lafayette is listed for 7 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 5.
The varsity soccer teams also travel Thursday. At New Albany, the girls are scheduled for 5 p.m. and the boys for 8 p.m. All start times are Central Standard Time.
